displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 987MA Series A modulating furnace (Form 987MA-01T). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 35 is 3 short and 5 long
meaning: Gas valve fault on a Bryant 987MA modulating furnace. The modulating gas valve failed to respond to a command from the furnace control, or power to the gas valve electronics was interrupted.
causes: Intermittent red, yellow, or orange wire at the gas valve
Intermittent red, yellow, or orange wire at connector PL8
diySteps: Count 3 short flashes and 5 long flashes. This code is from the 987MA modulating guide, not the 80% two-stage chart
If you smell gas, leave and call the gas supplier from outside
Technician: check the red, yellow, and orange wires at the gas valve and at PL8
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not jumper a modulating gas valve.
sourceTitle: Bryant 987MA Series A modulating furnace troubleshooting guide (Form 987MA-01T)
